# About
> First Edition is a premium Egyptian clothing brand selling exclusive, limited-edition Tshirts online.
> We are based in Egypt and deliver across all Egyptian governorates within 7 days.
> Payment is accepted via Vodafone Cash and InstaPay.
> This website was developed by Asher Media for Electronic Services — Commercial Register No. 11615.

## What We Sell
- Limited edition Tshirts with exclusive graphic designs
- Premium quality apparel for men
- Each product is part of a limited drop — once sold out, it does not return

## How to Order
- Browse products on the website
- Click "Order Now" on any product page
- Orders are delivered within 7 days across Egypt
- Payment methods: Vodafone Cash, InstaPay
